yarn-dinkum.meaning: All duties, conditions, qualifications and additional information kept, e.g. "You might have to do a one year probationary period." and "There's the chance to work from home, per Agency policy."
yarn-dinkum.sense: "spot on" for accurate, "ticked off" for accomplishing goals, "Have a squiz", "on your CV" and "new starters" all fit.
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural Australian workplace English with "Specialised", "organisations", "pro rata" and "CV"; "so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on" is a forced fit.
yarn-dinkum.register: A light level 3: conversational throughout ("Here's what the job involves"), with only a few slang touches ("Have a squiz", "ticked off", "sort it out properly"). Slightly under the brief. No swearing (permitted).
yarn-dinkum.tone: Keeps the plain, informative tone of a job ad.
yarn-dinkum.flow: Mostly smooth; "so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on" is ungrammatical.
yarn-dinkum.variety: Little to repeat; "Have a squiz" once, "Have a look" once.

dinkum-4.meaning: Everything kept; "2 full years of graduate study, each year at a higher level" is a fair gloss of "progressively higher level graduate education".
dinkum-4.sense: "the whole box and dice" for all these duties, "ticked off", "Have a squiz" all fit.
dinkum-4.authenticity: Natural, but leaves US "Specialized Experience" beside "specialised experience", and uses "résumé" where Australians say CV.
dinkum-4.register: Lightest of the three: mostly plain conversational English, with "the whole box and dice" and "Have a squiz" as the main Aussie touches. Under level 3. No swearing (permitted).
dinkum-4.flow: Smoothest of the three: "so they're published in a way that's legally effective, on time and accurate."
dinkum-4.variety: Little slang, but no repetition: "box and dice", "ticked off", "squiz", "on offer".

dinkum-3.meaning: All points kept; "so it's a union job" is a fair gloss of the bargaining unit line; "no worries:" is colour.
dinkum-3.sense: "nutting out production problems", "Get your head around what customers need", "pitching in as part of a team" all carry the right sense.
dinkum-3.authenticity: Sounds like an Australian HR writer: "If you get picked at a lower grade level, no worries", "Spotting and nutting out production problems".
dinkum-3.register: Right at level 3: a steady sprinkle of idiom ("Have a squiz", "pitching in", "nutting out", "ticked off") without becoming a yarn. No swearing (permitted).
dinkum-3.tone: Friendly but still a job ad.
dinkum-3.flow: Mostly smooth, but shares the clunk "so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on".
dinkum-3.variety: Varied: "no worries", "pitching in", "Get your head around", "nutting out", "squiz", "union job".

yarn-dinkum.quote: so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on
yarn-dinkum.original: to ensure legally effective, timely, and accurate publication of them
yarn-dinkum.why: Adjective stacked after published reads ungrammatically.

yarn-dinkum.quote: Have a squiz at that announcement for the details on the open period, eligibility, and how to apply.
yarn-dinkum.original: Please refer to that announcement for details on open period, eligibility, and how to apply.
yarn-dinkum.why: One of only a few slang touches; register slightly under level 3.

dinkum-4.quote: Specialized Experience: For the GS-09, you need one year of specialised experience
dinkum-4.original: Specialized Experience: For the GS-09, you must have one year of specialized experience
dinkum-4.why: Inconsistent spelling; US form left in the heading.
Australians would say CV or resume, not résumé.

dinkum-4.quote: Check that announcement for the details on the open period, who's eligible and how to apply.
dinkum-4.original: Please refer to that announcement for details on open period, eligibility, and how to apply.
dinkum-4.why: Register under level 3: much of the text is plain English.

dinkum-3.quote: so they get published legally effective, on time and spot on
dinkum-3.original: to ensure legally effective, timely, and accurate publication of them

summaries.dinkum-4: Clean and accurate, but lighter than asked.
summaries.dinkum-3: The best balance of weight, naturalness and accuracy.
